narratives.Overview: End medium-symlink series by migrating sinks onto Phase 1 API.
narratives.UserStory: As a security maintainer, I want high-risk write sinks on containedWrite with stricter verification, so that symlink path-escape mediums stop recurring at new call sites.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: Step 1: Migrate at least three product write sinks to packages/core/src/fs/contained-write.ts API. Step 2: Shrink allowlist in packages/core/src/verify-source/contained-writes.ts module. Step 3: Add enforce-path test evidence in contained-writes.test.ts. Step 4: CHANGELOG.md Phase 2 of #2951. Verify with vitest packages/core/src/fs and task verify:contained-writes. drive-to: merge-ready. CHANGELOG.md may be edited last with unique Unreleased bullets (shared non-exclusive).

narrative.Acceptance: When the PR merges, at least three former raw write call sites call containedWrite and tests return pass for those paths.
Given verify-source contained-writes inventory, the allowlist deletes migrated paths or records fewer exemptions than before.
When verify:contained-writes runs with --enforce against a fixture raw write, the command fails closed with a non-zero exit.
When CHANGELOG.md is opened, it records an Unreleased entry that cites Phase 2 of #2951.
